title: Gab Cast Do Not Transmit
description: A surreal scene depicts a pale humanoid figure with a cracked white mask and multiple brass horns protruding from its head, sitting inside a rusty, bathtublike machine emitting green smoke. The decaying room features a large green chalkboard labeled 'GAB CAST - DO NOT TRANSMIT' with maps and symbols, scattered papers, an owl-like bat creature, and a red sun over a barren purple landscape visible through a broken wall.
